newsitem.title: USA: Wang and Peritus sign license agreement.
newsitem.headline: Wang and Peritus sign license agreement.

text.p: Wang Laboratories Inc said on Wednesday that it had entered into an agreement to deploy the Automate:2000 Service technology of Peritus Software Services.

Peritus, which is privately-owned, will also provide training and support to Wang as it implements the technology, designed to identify and correct date-sensitive computer codes that are not equipped to function properly after the year 2000.
Terms of the license agreement were not disclosed.
Wang provides information technology outsourcing services.
